subject: prd/prd-review
statement: The reviewer shall cap review rounds at two per document per invocation moment; at the cap, the only recordable verdicts are approve, approve-with-advisories, or escalate.
rationale: the fuel gauge (— #D-2; AP-16/AP-19) — every review's cost is a known constant
fit_criterion: no fixture run records a third round; cap-hit fixtures end approve*/escalate (EVAL-5)
